ID: Key, used in this sheet only
SkuId: Web Store Sku, used to match a Web Store purchase to a Hydra product
Name: Loc key from LocalizationWebStore.csv or SourceWebStore.csv for the name of the pack
Description: Optional, loc key from LocalizationWebStore.csv or SourceWebStore.csv for the description of the pack
WebStoreIcon: Icon to display in the web store
WebStoreDisplaySku: The sku used to preview what items will be granted in the Web Store. NOTE: this is unrelated to the item id values used by DCWC. Reference config/xsolla_config/template.json for possible values
WebStoreDisplayQuantity: The quantity used to preview what items will be granted in the Web Store. NOTE: this is unrelated to the actual quantities in rewards data
Group: The Xsolla Package Group for the sku
